items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16

ctx.x: And, and, and he got up out of bed and we stole out. And Mama went to the market. And, and we stole out and we made all around. He took me, you know, he used to like race horses. And he took me by Pratt's and by the people who had his diamonds. Farron Tellers.
And made a round of all the places where he used to go downtown, you know. And then he came back home. Was the last time.
